description: Source code for game mechanics related to unit actions, battles, recruitment, and victory conditions in the Wesnoth game engine.

classes.name: castle_cost_calculator
classes.description: Calculates movement cost for castle tiles based on map location.

methods.name: set_victory_when_enemies_defeated
methods.description: Sets the victory condition to be when enemies are defeated.

methods.name: victory_when_enemies_defeated
methods.description: Returns whether victory condition is set to when enemies are defeated.

methods.name: can_recruit_on
methods.description: Checks if a unit can recruit on a specific map location.

methods.name: recruit_unit
methods.description: Handles recruiting a new unit at a specified location, including visual effects and checksum validation.

methods.name: under_leadership
methods.description: Determines the best leader under whose leadership a unit is, and calculates leadership bonus.

methods.name: pr_atleast
methods.description: Calculates probability that damage is at least a certain amount.

methods.name: pr_between
methods.description: Calculates probability that damage falls within a range.

methods.name: reduce
methods.description: Reduces swing pair index based on attack order.

methods.name: pr_kills_during
methods.description: Calculates probability that one unit kills another during a series of swings.

methods.name: evaluate_battle_stats
methods.description: Evaluates and returns battle statistics between attacker and defender units.

methods.name: unit_dump
methods.description: Returns a string representation of a unit and its location.

methods.name: attack
methods.description: Executes an attack between two units, handling attack loops, damage calculation, and visual updates.
